Method of Attack: Infecting routers and IoT devices with malware to launch DDoS attacks
Using a Mirai botnet to perform DDoS attacks on banks and ISPs
Impacted Systems: UK routers from Postal Office, TalkTalk, and Kcom ISPs
Attack Vector: Mirai malware infection of routers and IoT devices
Botnet rental and use for DDoS attacks
Indicators of Compromise: Mirai malware source code released on HackForums
DDoS attacks on Lloyds and Barclays in January 2017
DDoS attacks on Deutsche Telekom routers in late 2016
DDoS attacks on UK routers in late 2016
Payment of $10,000 to attack Liberian ISP
Date of Discovery: Late November 2016 (Mirai malware caused Deutsche Telekom routers outage)
Early December 2016 (Mirai malware caused UK routers outage)
Late July 2017 (BestBuy pleaded guilty in German court)
